source.name: chicagofirefc.com – 'Chicago Fire FC Unveils New "Forever Red" Kit to Heat Up 2026 Season'
source.quote: Chicago's soccer Club drops newest jersey – featuring front-of-kit partner Carvana – with Valentine's Day launch event

source.name: FOR SOCCER – '2026 MLS Jersey Sponsors'
source.quote: media partner Apple, once again, will be on the left sleeve of every jersey
source.note: League-wide left-sleeve patch; Apple pays MLS, not the club (see deal mls-apple-tv).

source.name: FOR SOCCER – '2026 MLS Jersey Sponsors'
source.quote: Chicago Fire FC Apple TV Media Magellan Corporation Distribution / Supply Chain
source.note: Right sleeve for 2026, from the sleeves table's Chicago Fire FC row. The club announced Magellan as Official Jersey Sleeve Sponsor on 2024-05-03: https://www.chicagofirefc.com/news/chicago-fire-fc-announces-magellan-corporation-as-official-jersey-sleeve-sponsor

summary: All MLS clubs wear Adidas; Apple TV is on the left sleeve of every kit. Carvana fronts the jersey and Magellan Corporation is on the right sleeve.
